tha-ap194:1.1: yaṁ dāyavāsiko → yadā vanavāsī (cck); yadā vanavāsiko (sya-all) | dāyavāsiko → yadā vanavāsī (bj: machasaṁ) | vanavāsī → yaṁ dāyavāsiko (cck: sī.)
tha-ap194:1.3: padakkhiṇāvaṭṭā pathabyā → padakkhiṇāvattā puthavyā (bj); padakkhiṇāvattā paṭhabyā (sya-all); padakkhiṇā vattā puṭhavyā (pts) | padakkhiṇāvattā → sabbe padakkhiṇāvaṇaṭā (bj: machasaṁ) | padakkhiṇāvaṭṭā → padakkhiṇāvattā (cck: sī. syā.)
tha-ap194:1.4: puthavyā → pathabyā (bj: machasaṁ) | pathabyā → puthavyā (cck: sī.)
tha-ap194:2.2: dharaṇuttame → dharaṇimuttame (sya-all) | dharaṇuttame tīṇeva → dharaṇimuttame tiṇe ca (pts)
tha-ap194:3.4: devamānusasatthuno catunnavutito → satthuno devamānusā catunavute ito (bj)
